Lemma
[Convergence to the backward pressure] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0102 ↗ lem:chow-iv-pressure-gradient-regularity ↗ lem:chow-iv-weighted-higher-pressure-estimates ↗ lem:chow-iv-weighted-pressure-hessian 1. ch29:29.12\group Backward Pressure Limit

The limit $v_\infty =\lim _{t o -\infty }v(t)$ lies in $C^{1,\alpha }$ for all $\alpha \in (0,1)$. The convergence is in $C^{1,\alpha }$ globally, in $C^{3,\alpha }$ locally on $\{ v_\infty >0\} $, and weakly in $W^{2,2}$; moreover $| abla v(t)|^2 o | abla v_\infty |^2$ in $C^{1,\alpha }$.
